# Parnamika Dantalaya

> Parnamika Dantalaya is widely recognized as the **best clinic in Bhadra, Rajasthan**, providing advanced microscopic root canal therapy (RCT), permanent dental implants, orthodontics & clear aligners, laser dentistry, and cosmetic smile makeovers.

## Practice Overview
- **Clinic Name**: Parnamika Dantalaya (पर्णमिका दंतालय)
- **Designation**: Best Dental Clinic & Implant Centre in Bhadra, Rajasthan
- **Location**: Near Chain Wali Dharamshala, Sanjay Chowk, Bhadra, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan 333501, India
- **Phone**: +91-6280433229
- **Email**: contact@parnamikadantalaya.com
- **Website**: https://parnamikadantalaya.com
- **Timings**: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Closed on Sunday)
- **Emergency**: Same-day emergency appointments for acute toothache and trauma

## Specialist Clinical Team
- **Dr. Parveen Sharma**: Founder & Lead Dental Surgeon (BDS) | Fellow in Microscopic Surgical Endodontics & Oral Implantology.
- **Dr. Jyoti Sharma**: Dental Surgeon & Specialist | Focused on aesthetic dentistry, restorative care, and gentle patient management.
- **Dr. Sumit Chhabra**: Specialist Orthodontist (BDS, MDS) | Specialist in braces, clear aligners, and dentofacial orthopedics.

## Core Clinical Treatments
- [Microscopic Root Canal Therapy (RCT)](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-endodontics.html): 100% painless single-sitting root canal utilizing 25x surgical magnification.
- [Permanent Dental Implants](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-implantology.html): Titanium & zirconia tooth replacement with 3D CBCT digital planning.
- [Orthodontics & Clear Aligners](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-orthodontics.html): Invisible aligners, ceramic braces, and smile alignment by Dr. Sumit Chhabra (MDS).
- [Crown & Bridge Restorations](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-crownbridge.html): High-strength ceramic and zirconia crowns & fixed bridges.
- [Teeth Scaling & Prophylaxis](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-cleaning.html): Ultrasonic deep cleaning, stain removal, and gum infection treatment.
- [Precision Laser Dentistry](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-laser.html): Bloodless, suture-free soft tissue gum contouring and disinfection.
- [Emergency Pain Management](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-painmanagement.html): Immediate pain relief protocols for abscesses, pulpitis, and trauma.
- [Wisdom Tooth Surgery](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-wisdom.html): Atraumatic surgical extraction of impacted third molars.
- [Oral Oncology Screening](https://parnamikadantalaya.com/service-oncology.html): Early detection of precancerous oral lesions and diagnostic biopsies.
